card.text: The hotter giant of Capella, 8.8 times the Sun's width, orbiting its partner every 104 days.

introduction.text: Its orbit weighs it at 2.48 solar masses; it is 8.83 solar radii, 5,730 K at its surface, and spins every 8.5 days.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
